About profile scenarios

Published associations for BMI, Ba, age, and current smoking are applied as an exploratory log-odds shift. Overall POP-Q stage is not used: its published estimate was imprecise and overlaps anatomically with Ba. Source estimates are not conditional on this patient profile. Scenarios are not calibrated individual predictions.

Reference profile: BMI 26, Ba 0 cm, age below 60, no current smoking, no levator avulsion. Coefficients are independently sampled because joint covariance was not published. The optional levator association comes from anatomical recurrence and is extrapolated to clinical composites. Other outcomes have no profile adjustment.
